judgment.scope_reasoning: What exists is one line in a standardisation plan: SAC has approved a project for a recommended national standard on AI deep synthesis security (plan 20264769-T-469, due for approval by 31 Dec 2027), with no draft text. The register covers instruments, including drafts and pending bills, but neither AGENTS.md section 10 nor pipeline/scope-decisions.md says whether an approved standardisation project with no text counts, and a record could say only what the standard will be about. Suggested rule for a human: no record for a plan item; record the standard when its draft for comment is published, and meanwhile mention the project in the notes of CN-02 (deep synthesis provisions). The same list holds about a dozen other AI-related projects (items 7, 9 and 13 to 23), so the decision sets a precedent for all of them.
judgment.status_reasoning: No status fits: there is no text; a planned standard is neither a draft nor adopted. The plan was issued on 2026-09-30 and the standard is due for approval by 2027-12-31.

open_questions: Scope: does an approved national standardisation project with no draft text (plan 20264769-T-469, 网络安全技术 人工智能深度合成安全规范) get a record?
